short_scenes.narration: Volt's RLC problem needs a differential equation. He groans.
With Laplace, derivatives become multiplication by s. Solve with algebra, look up the table, and you get this exact curve.

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.narration: Laplace changes time into a new variable, s. Derivatives become simple multiplication, so a hard differential equation becomes easy algebra, then we convert back.

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.narration: Inductors become s L, capacitors one over s C.
